summary: Treat a column as a separator exactly when both of its cells are zero, then read maximal nonseparator runs left to right. A one-column run is a straight step; a wider run whose upper-left cell is zero turns left, otherwise it turns right. Starting from row 1, column 3, paint two red cells for each step while advancing the state, then return the trace on a fixed black 8x7 canvas with a green marker at row 0, column 3.
